result.note: Tests the Cabinet-approved outlays for Semicon 2.0 and the accompanying mobile-phone manufacturing allocation.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Union Cabinet approved Semicon 2.0. Consider the following statements:
items: Semicon 2.0 is a semiconductor programme with an outlay of USD 13.3 billion.
It was approved alongside a separate USD 6.5 billion allocation for mobile-phone manufacturing.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. The Cabinet approved the USD 13.3 billion Semicon 2.0 programme on 16 July 2026, together with USD 6.5 billion for mobile-phone manufacturing. The programme marks a shift from landing chip factories to building the ecosystem around them.
questions.source: The Cabinet approved Semicon 2.0, a USD 13.3 billion semiconductor programme, alongside USD 6.5 billion for mobile-phone manufacturing
